paragraphs: Hi, I'm Vidubha Sankha — a Software Engineering undergraduate at the University of Vavuniya, Sri Lanka. I have hands-on experience in full-stack development, database management, and AI-based applications.

I am skilled in React.js, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, and REST APIs, with experience developing real-world web projects and intelligent solutions. I am seeking a software engineering opportunity to apply my skills and grow as a professional developer.

tabs.problem: Educational institutions need an efficient way to manage student records, academic information, and administrative activities without manual overhead.
tabs.process: I developed a web-based Student Information Management System designed to handle these administrative tasks seamlessly. The system includes secure user authentication and comprehensive CRUD operations for managing student data.
tabs.outcome: Outcome: Deployed a secure, centralized system that simplifies student record management and improves administrative efficiency.

tabs.problem: Connecting customers with home service providers often relies on fragmented manual processes or overly complex booking platforms.
tabs.process: I developed a web-based system using PHP and MySQL to act as a centralized marketplace. The project involved designing the full-stack architecture, including relational database design and secure backend routing.
tabs.outcome: Outcome: Successfully built a full-stack application capable of connecting customers with service providers while effectively managing the underlying databases.

tabs.problem: Road networks in Sri Lanka suffer from undocumented damage like potholes and cracks, and manual inspection is resource-heavy and slow.
tabs.process: I developed a machine learning-based system to detect road damage automatically using image processing and AI techniques, trained to identify local road conditions.
tabs.outcome: Outcome: Demonstrated the ability to build intelligent solutions and analyze real-world problems using data, deploying a model that can identify road distress effectively.
